novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 (growing-profile-band)
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed strict extension is against only KimKimKennedy2026; the other cited papers are input-theory comparators, not a second competing causal quantizer result or a generic-class extension.

soundness_flags.label: H_{P^(n),K} and ass:curvature
soundness_flags.one_line: The class does not assume that the population distortion is twice differentiable at its optimizer, so its declared Hessian H and curvature eigenvalue can be undefined under the stated margin condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:bounded-feature
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited causal-k-means source assumes bounded individual outcome-regression coordinates, not the proposal's normalized contrast restriction |mu_1-mu_0|<=1 or b in [0,1].

soundness_flags.label: ass:score-envelope
soundness_flags.one_line: With bounded Y, fixed overlap, finite K_n, and positive sigma coordinates, every standardized adjacent score is bounded for each row, so B_n(P^(n))<infinity is automatic; retain a quantitative growth restriction only through Gamma_n.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3 and Open-ended Question 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The proposal does not assume or claim a matching multi-coordinate converse for every component of Gamma_n or for the simultaneous sqrt(log K_n) penalty.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The lower-bound headline is accepted only as coordinatewise standardized-separation necessity; sharp joint-frontier necessity remains open.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add twice differentiability of the population distortion at every listed optimizer, or replace the Hessian condition by a fully defined local quadratic-growth modulus; retag the normalized feature-support restriction as novel with an application-facing justification, and delete the automatic finite-envelope assumption.

Lift the flagship comparator-chain floor by proving the growing-K result for an explicitly defined generic class of fixed-resolution causal-quantizer risk procedures that contains the KimKimKennedy2026 construction, with a strict non-representability or extension statement rather than only one named-paper comparison.

Strengthen the converse program from the coordinatewise Le Cam result to a named Assouad or Le Cam chain over multiple adjacent gains, explicitly identifying at least one necessary Gamma_n component up to logarithms.

recommended_next_step: Revise the class so curvature is defined and assumptions are correctly tagged, then add a genuine generic-class or two-comparator extension claim before resubmitting for flagship review.
